# v1 generated daemon config evidence

Date/time: 2026-07-16 01:41 CDT

Commit: d77df0eef449559f03f4075cfe1b35b84590c95c

## Scope implemented

Implemented only `v1.mail-core.generated-config`.

Added deterministic generated config files to the existing render set for:

- `front/nginx.conf`
- `postfix/gophermailforge.conf`
- `dovecot/gophermailforge.conf`
- `rspamd/gophermailforge.conf`
- `webmail/provider.conf`

Each generated file now starts with:

```text
# Generated by GopherMailForge. Do not edit directly.
# Source: generated_config_set=<id> input_hash=<hash>
```

The generated daemon config points Postfix, Dovecot, and Rspamd at the v1 internal HTTP/JSON contract endpoints implemented by `v1.mail-core.daemon-contracts`.
